scope: 17 existing full runs, 85 rank traces; no training launched

semantics.compute: Forward/backward plus local optimizer in Local SGD
semantics.wait: Elapsed sample-count gather; not a standalone barrier or pure network timer
semantics.model_sync: Complete model sync in step trace, regardless of collective
semantics.payload_call: Elapsed payload MPI call; includes waiting, not pure wire time
semantics.local_work_windows: Data plus compute duration only; not synchronized timestamps or arrival order
semantics.retrospective_targets: Sum epoch_time until first validation crossing; excludes some loop overhead, targets selected retrospectively; not exact wall time
semantics.rank_maxima: Maximum of per-rank totals; never added to another rank or to a maximum of another metric
